title: Executors 7% utilized: ~401 idle executor-hours held
fix: Fix the tail that keeps the final job alive (speculation for stragglers, skew fixes) - releasing executors mid-query is not achievable via shuffleTracking.timeout, which only applies after the referencing job ends.

title: Stage 10 wide shuffle (3660 GiB, ~3748 MiB/partition)

title: Stage 13 spends 67% of task time waiting on shuffle fetch
fix: Check which executors hold the map output before changing partition counts. If it is concentrated (the map stage ran while the fleet was still scaling up), raise dynamicAllocation.initialExecutors so the map stage spreads its output; raising spark.sql.shuffle.partitions then makes it WORSE by multiplying block count. Raise partitions only when the blocks themselves are large.

title: Stage 19 straggler: slowest task 11.7x the median on uniform data
fix: Enable spark.speculation=true (with spark.speculation.quantile ~0.9) so a straggling task is re-launched on an idle executor instead of pinning the stage.

If it is concentrated (the map stage ran while the fleet was still scaling up), raise dynamicAllocation.initialExecutors so the map stage spreads its output; raising spark.sql.shuffle.partitions then makes it WORSE by multiplying block count. Raise partitions only when the blocks themselves are large.

title: Stage 367 spends 34% of task time waiting on shuffle fetch
fix: Check which executors hold the map output before changing partition counts. If it is concentrated (the map stage ran while the fleet was still scaling up), raise dynamicAllocation.initialExecutors so the map stage spreads its output; raising spark.sql.shuffle.partitions then makes it WORSE by multiplying block count. Raise partitions only when the blocks themselves are large.
